requiredCapabilities: brand strategy and channel conflict mitigation

assignments.mission: Evaluate options A/B/C using given constraints (capacity, margins, cash flow, contract terms). Choose one option and articulate: key reason, strongest counterargument, pivotal assumption that could flip the choice, and a 3-year operational plan to manage the chosen path’s biggest risk. Use only provided info; state conditionals where data is missing.

Assess brand equity and channel-conflict risks across A/B/C. For the selected option, design a concrete 3-year plan to protect the self-owned brand (positioning, SKU/recipe differentiation, scarcity management, seasonality allocation, messaging, and founder bandwidth relief) within fixed capacity and timing limits.

reason: Decision hinges on financial/operational tradeoffs and brand/channel risk. A business strategist selects and justifies the path; a brand strategist crafts the mitigation plan. No external research is needed to decide, so two specialists are sufficient.
